The dependencies (gtk3, webkit2gtk-4.1, libappindicator-gtk3) are consistent with a Tauri/GTK desktop application.

The only minor note is that the `url=` field points to `stirling.com` while the source originates from `Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF` on GitHub, but this is a metadata field and does not affect the build or runtime behavior. No supply-chain attack indicators are present.</details>
